messages.content: Create a mix track using notes of C major scale and duration of each note being quarter of a second with a duration of 3 minutes.

We can interpret 'quarter' as quarter of a whole note. But the user specifically says quarter of a second. The function doesn't support specifying duration in seconds. So we might need to approximate: maybe 'quarter' note corresponds to quarter of a whole note. But we don't know the tempo. The function likely uses default tempo. But we can still pass 'quarter' as note_duration.

Thus we call the function with scale: "C Major", note_duration: "quarter", track_length: 180.
